newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares in less demand, index slips.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares in less demand, index slips.

text.p: Latvian share prices slipped lower on Friday as the heavy demand that marked business earlier in the week slackened off, dealers said.
Market trade came to 157,000 lats versus 320,000 lats on Thursday and the Rietumu Bank index dipped 0.32 percent to 232.06.

Leading bank Unibanka saw the heaviest trade of 51,900 lats but dipped in price to 4.99 lats from five lats. Staburadze was the only gainer on the official list, adding two santimes to 2.99 lats on turnover of 9,100 lats while Riga Transport Fleet was again stable at 1.70 on trade of 16,600 lats.
The most active stock on the secondary list was Valmiera Glassfibre, which turned over 14,800 lats and dipped to 2.20 lats from 2.25.
Daugavpils Chain was also busy on 13,400 lats of turnover as it also slipped to 2.83 lats from 2.84.
Other active stocks included fish cannery Salacgriva on trade of 10,000 lats and was stable at 5.20 lats and Lode Brick, which saw activity of 8,000 lats as it addded five santimes to 1.50 lats.
